Dear Mr. Mohammed,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced during your stay. We completely understand your frustration regarding the leak, air conditioning issue, and the cleaning visit despite your request.

We have received your payment, and we truly appreciate your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you are considering moving out.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Please accept our sincere apologies once again, and let us know if there is anything we can do to assist you.
